items.title: Damon Wayans To Guest Star On NBC’s ‘St. Denis Medical’ Season 3 Premiere In ‘In Living Color’ Reunion; First-Look Photo
items.summary: Damon Wayans will guest star in the Season 3 premiere of NBC's St. Denis Medical as Dr. Highland, a charming but self-important new addition to the hospital. The role puts him back onscreen with David Alan Grier, his former In Living Color castmate, who is a series regular. Deadline also published a first-look photo from the episode.

items.title: Jerry Katzman, Former William Morris President, Dies at 89
items.summary: Jerry Katzman, who rose to president of William Morris over a 30-year run at the agency, has died at 89. His packaging work helped assemble The Cosby Show, Roseanne, Murphy Brown and The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air. He was the son of a producer of Elvis Presley movies.

items.title: Mariska Hargitay’s Best ‘Law & Order: SVU’ Episodes To Re-Air On NBC
items.summary: NBC is running a Law & Order: Special Victims Unit marathon built around Mariska Hargitay's standout episodes, timed to her hosting gig at the upcoming Emmy Awards. The network lists the marathon for Thursday, Sept. 10, with the Season 28 premiere airing Thursday, Oct. 8 at 9 p.m. ET/PT.

items.title: Outside Lands 2026 Photo Gallery: The Strokes, Turnstile, Geese, Lucy Dacus, and More
items.summary: Consequence has posted its photo gallery from Outside Lands 2026 in San Francisco, with shots by Raymond Ahner and staff. The images cover sets from The Strokes, Turnstile, Geese and Lucy Dacus, among others.

items.title: Fuerza Regida Announces New “This Is Our Dream” US Tour Dates
items.summary: Fuerza Regida has added dates to its This Is Our Dream tour, a 10-show US run beginning in October.

items.title: Rufus Wainwright, Kathleen Hanna, Yo La Tengo Celebrate the Radical Music of Yoko Ono
items.summary: Yoko Only, a tribute concert built around Yoko Ono's catalog, brought together Rufus Wainwright, Kathleen Hanna and Yo La Tengo for performances and collaborations. The night focused on Ono's experimental songwriting, feminist politics and the influence she has had on the artists who followed her.

items.title: ‘The Last House’ Star Wagner Moura Talks the Netflix Chart-Topper and Why He Believes the Tide Is Turning for Latino Actors
items.summary: Wagner Moura discussed The Last House, currently topping the Netflix charts, and his view that opportunities are opening up for Latino actors. He also recalled the collision of the biggest honor of his career, a top prize at Cannes, with a shooting day that had him picking up dog excrement on camera.

items.title: ‘Love Island USA’ Stars Aniya and Melanie Pitch Themselves As Potential New KATSEYE Members
items.summary: Love Island USA's Aniya and Melanie made a case for joining KATSEYE, taking on the choreography from the group's single "Gnarly."
